value.body: A quality control analyst inspects and tests materials or products to check they meet set standards. Manufacturers, testing laboratories and inspection agencies across electronics, metals, chemicals and consumer goods hire them. A day involves sampling, running tests on instruments, comparing results to specifications and recording data.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers join as QC trainees or lab analysts through walk-in drives, campus placement or testing-lab openings. Lab experience from college and familiarity with measurement instruments help.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Recording data and preparing test reports

value.title: At a glance
items: Work is often lab- or plant-based and may involve shifts.
Common next roles: senior analyst, QA officer, lab in-charge, quality manager.
Knowledge of standards and audits grows in importance with seniority.
